notifyCompletion.description: Whether Clio should notify the assigner on task completion.

descriptionFormat.description: Replacement description interpretation; omit to preserve the current format.

estimatedTimeValue.description: Replacement time_estimated in unspecified provider-defined units; no unit conversion is asserted.

changes.description: Partial task changes; omission preserves existing values, null is not accepted, and assignment is full replacement.

expectedEtag.description: Optional current revision from get-task; reject the update if it no longer matches.

FunctionInput_clio_updatetask.description: Task identity, partial changes, and optional revision protection.

etag.description: New opaque revision if returned; use get-task for full updated task details.

FunctionOutput_clio_updatetask.description: Acknowledgment of the task update, not notification delivery.

tags.instructions: Obtain a task ID from `list-tasks`; use `get-task` for current values and an etag. Omitted changes stay unchanged. Assignment replaces the entire current set: one contact or 1–10 firm users, never a mixture; empty cannot unassign. Changing status to complete may notify the assigner. Use `delete-task` to delete, not complete, a task. Cascading calendar rules belong to Clio.
